definitions.question: 08:30–16:00 ordinary Mean SessionPath forecast-box range-multiple reach: overall baseline and pre-08:30 tail-event cohorts.
definitions.ruler: U=08:30 decision open+Mean up; D=open−Mean down; W=U−D. Upward multiple m is D+mW; downward is U−mW. A89–91 box has1.2 targets91.40 and88.60. These lines use the ordinary forecast box, not the orange AVR expansion rectangles, BBOX, or statistical standard deviations.
definitions.fit: Four Own/Prior Exact/Wide methods remain separate. Saved clean forecasts were reconstructed with the production matching engine and strictly earlier complete matched dates. Means are averages of each earlier day’s actual excursion divided by that day’s frozen AVR, converted with the forecast day’s AVR. Current day outcome is never used to fit its box.
definitions.precision: Decision open and Mean distances serialized to six decimals, matching the production forecast code; no tick rounding. EPS1e-9 handles floating arithmetic only.
definitions.outcome: Complete valid five-minute candles [08:30,16:00); 16:00 opening candle excluded. Target reach is a wick touch, including equality. Initial breakout requires strict high>U or low<D. No-break days remain in unconditional denominators.
definitions.unconditional: All eligible fitted days in that market, method and cohort. Upper, lower, either and both reach probabilities each use that same denominator. Upper/lower hits may overlap.
definitions.first: Conditional on a resolved first strict wick breakout of the Mean box in08:30–16:00. First-UP and first-DOWN displayed separately, plus their pooled descriptive rate. First-side target hits include those in the breakout candle. Same-candle two-sided initial breaks are excluded from first-side denominators and counted separately.
definitions.confirmation: The breakout candle confirms five minutes after its opening timestamp. Already-before-confirmation counts targets reached through that whole trigger candle. Next-open gaps touching or passing the target are a separate already-reached-at-entry group. Pending targets exclude both groups, require at least one remaining candle, and are scored only on candles after the trigger candle. pendingHit’s denominator is pendingN. This is target-only continuation research, not a tested entry/stop strategy.
definitions.tails: ALL is overall NY baseline. 0430_U/D means second strict wick side of frozen[previous19:30,04:30) range was breached in[04:30,08:30), known by08:30. ORANGE03_U/D and ORANGE05_U/D mean both outer orange expansion targets were touched in the completed03–05 or05–08:30 window, direction=second target touched. Same-candle unknown second direction excluded. No selection on the NY orange outcome.
definitions.minimum: minFit1 and50 are reported separately. NY Mean forecast must have at least minFit earlier matches. For an orange tail group, its earlier orange forecast must independently have at least that many matches. No minimum fit applies to plain04:30 events. Primary50-match orange slices can contain very few dates.
definitions.yearly: Each scored year is a subset of the earlier-only forecast records; changing the display year does not refit boxes on that year alone.
definitions.timing: Hit timestamps name candle opening time; fully observable at candle close five minutes later. Gaps and ambiguous intrabar order are explicit. Events and four NY methods can share dates and must not be added as independent observations.
definitions.limits: This retrospective GC replication examines overlapping outcomes within the same historical sample. Earlier-only boxes prevent self/future fitting; frequencies are retrospective chronological measurements, not untouched prospective forecasts. Wilson95% intervals are descriptive and do not adjust for serial dependence or multiple comparisons. No news cause, transaction costs, entry/stop rules or trade win rates are inferred.
